_about: The language engine's feature model (engine-design § 4; RGL Sindhi's feature set as a checklist, the values the family's Kutchi shows). No Kutchi words here. A value in a feature's `hyp` list is a reserved slot that no data may use until Mum confirms it (the validator rejects it). `defaultCell` is the form a word takes when a rule names no cell; `{x}` reads a feature from the word itself, then from the phrase it sits in, then from the slot's case. `addressee` maps an abstract person to the one said, by who is spoken to (rule G6).

gender.defaultSrc: Mum's rule for an unknown gender: grammar-notes §24 B4, §37.5, §50 (C60); decision 21, decision 30 (f)

case.notes: dir = the plain form; obl = before a postposition (grammar-notes §41, §49); dat = the 'to me' form (§1, §9); voc = calling out (§36 C21)

person.src: grammar-notes §21 (respect), §51 (be by person), §13 (hi/hu point, not person: kept as hyp)

Gen.notes: the 'of' word: agrees with the thing owned (grammar-notes §47)
